what: The thin 3em line to the left of the 「More」 text link folds away on its right end as the axis in .4s ease (scaleX 0), and the 2em circle on the right switches instantly from a dark fill (light dot in the center) to a light translucent fill (dark dot in the center · thin border). On release the line extends again to the same length. In the no-line type (look: bare) only the circle changes

options.--fx-gap: Gap between line and text (via style), default .5em
options.--fx-line-dur: Length of the line fold (set via style), default .4s
options.look: bare shows only the circle without a line (original nonline — News ‹More› and ‹Before you use›)

note: The original swaps the circle’s background between two svgs (btn_icon2 → btn_icon1) so the color changes instantly without mixing (even with transition: all .3s on it, the image doesn’t blend). The part draws the same shape with two radial-gradients and switches background-image.

from.where: index.html .kz-more (the More of Rooms, Dining, Facilities, Sauna and the three Shortcuts, nonline before News and Usage) — original .btn_basic a::before width 3em · transform-origin right · transition all .4s ease → :hover scaleX(0), ::after btn_icon2 → btn_icon1
